step: Load SKU master from ERP export
turn: The SKU master loading step is finished. I added a test in tests/sku/test_parse.py that writes a small Latin-1 encoded, semicolon-delimited ERP export with one Mozzarella item whose dimensions are 300 x 200 x 150 mm. It checks that read_items returns the dimensions converted to centimetres, (30.0, 20.0, 15.0). The test covers the Latin-1 encoding, the semicolon delimiter and the millimetre-to-centimetre conversion in one pass. I haven't run the suite in this message, so I can't report a pass result. In the same commit I made one small unrelated fix. I noticed the test helper left the temporary CSV path built by string concatenation, and I switched it to pathlib joining so it behaves the same on every platform. Next I'll start on "Read locations from WMS API".

sidefix.title: Use pathlib for temp CSV path
sidefix.what: Replaced string-concatenated temporary CSV path in the test helper with pathlib joining for cross-platform consistency.
